audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar tabernacle transport-duty text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Kohathite, Gershonite, and Merarite service ages, covering of holy objects, transport boundaries, named oversight, clan counts, and service burdens. Anti-exclusion, worker-safety, and service-without-superiority safeguards required.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Lift up head/count sons of Kohath from midst of sons of Levi, by clans and houses of fathers,

familiar.text: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,

modern.text: “Take a census of the Kohathites among the Levites by their clans and families,

original.text: נָשֹׂ֗א אֶת רֹאשׁ֙ בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֔ת מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם

verses.restored: from thirty years old and upward to fifty years old, all entering host to do work in tent of meeting.

familiar.text: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: men from thirty to fifty years old—everyone who is qualified to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל בָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מְלָאכָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: This is service of sons of Kohath in tent of meeting: Holy of Holies things.

familiar.text: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:

modern.text: This service of the Kohathites at the Tent of Meeting regards the most holy things.

original.text: זֹ֛את עֲבֹדַ֥ת בְּנֵי קְהָ֖ת בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד קֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים

verses.restored: When camp sets out, Aaron and his sons shall come and take down veil of screen and cover ark of testimony with it.

familiar.text: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:

modern.text: Whenever the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons are to go in, take down the veil of the curtain, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it.

original.text: וּבָ֨א אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ בִּנְסֹ֣עַ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְהוֹרִ֕דוּ אֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֣כֶת הַמָּסָ֑ךְ וְכִ֨סּוּ בָ֔הּ אֵ֖ת אֲרֹ֥ן הָעֵדֻֽת

verses.restored: They shall put covering of fine leather over it, spread cloth entirely blue above, and put in its poles.

familiar.text: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.

modern.text: They are to place over this a covering of fine leather, spread a solid blue cloth over it, and insert its poles.

original.text: וְנָתְנ֣וּ עָלָ֗יו כְּסוּי֙ ע֣וֹר תַּ֔חַשׁ וּפָרְשׂ֧וּ בֶֽגֶד כְּלִ֛יל תְּכֵ֖לֶת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְשָׂמ֖וּ בַּדָּֽיו

verses.restored: Over table of presence they shall spread blue cloth and put on it dishes, pans, bowls, and jars for drink offering; continual bread shall be upon it.

familiar.text: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:

modern.text: Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and place the plates and cups on it, along with the bowls and pitchers for the drink offering. The regular bread offering is to remain on it.

original.text: וְעַ֣ל שֻׁלְחַ֣ן הַפָּנִ֗ים יִפְרְשׂוּ֮ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵלֶת֒ וְנָתְנ֣וּ עָ֠לָיו אֶת הַקְּעָרֹ֤ת וְאֶת הַכַּפֹּת֙ וְאֶת הַמְּנַקִּיֹּ֔ת וְאֵ֖ת קְשׂ֣וֹת הַנָּ֑סֶךְ וְלֶ֥חֶם הַתָּמִ֖יד עָלָ֥יו יִהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: They shall spread over them scarlet cloth, cover it with covering of fine leather, and put in its poles.

familiar.text: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.

modern.text: And they shall spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover them with fine leather, and insert the poles.

original.text: וּפָרְשׂ֣וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם בֶּ֚גֶד תּוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י וְכִסּ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְשָׂמ֖וּ אֶת בַּדָּֽיו

verses.restored: They shall take blue cloth and cover lampstand of light, its lamps, tongs, firepans, and all oil vessels with which they serve it.

familiar.text: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:

modern.text: They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand used for light, together with its lamps, wick trimmers, and trays, as well as the jars of oil with which to supply it.

original.text: וְלָקְח֣וּ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֗לֶת וְכִסּ֞וּ אֶת מְנֹרַ֤ת הַמָּאוֹר֙ וְאֶת נֵ֣רֹתֶ֔יהָ וְאֶת מַלְקָחֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת מַחְתֹּתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵת֙ כָּל כְּלֵ֣י שַׁמְנָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָׁרְתוּ לָ֖הּ בָּהֶֽם

verses.restored: They shall put it and all its vessels into covering of fine leather and place it on carrying frame.

familiar.text: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put it upon a bar.

modern.text: Then they shall wrap it and all its utensils inside a covering of fine leather and put it on the carrying frame.

original.text: וְנָתְנ֤וּ אֹתָהּ֙ וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלֶ֔יהָ אֶל מִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְנָתְנ֖וּ עַל הַמּֽוֹט

verses.restored: Over gold altar they shall spread blue cloth, cover it with covering of fine leather, and put in its poles.

familiar.text: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:

modern.text: Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth, cover it with fine leather, and insert the poles.

original.text: וְעַ֣ל מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֗ב יִפְרְשׂוּ֙ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְכִסּ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְשָׂמ֖וּ אֶת בַּדָּֽיו

verses.restored: They shall take all vessels of service with which they serve in holy place, put them in blue cloth, cover them with covering of fine leather, and place them on carrying frame.

familiar.text: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put them on a bar:

modern.text: They are to take all the utensils for serving in the sanctuary, place them in a blue cloth, cover them with fine leather, and put them on the carrying frame.

original.text: וְלָקְחוּ֩ אֶת כָּל כְּלֵ֨י הַשָּׁרֵ֜ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְשָֽׁרְתוּ בָ֣ם בַּקֹּ֗דֶשׁ וְנָֽתְנוּ֙ אֶל בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְכִסּ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔ם בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְנָתְנ֖וּ עַל הַמּֽוֹט

verses.restored: They shall remove ashes from altar and spread purple cloth over it.

familiar.text: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:

modern.text: Then they shall remove the ashes from the bronze altar, spread a purple cloth over it,

original.text: וְדִשְּׁנ֖וּ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּפָרְשׂ֣וּ עָלָ֔יו בֶּ֖גֶד אַרְגָּמָֽן

verses.restored: They shall put upon it all its vessels with which they serve: firepans, forks, shovels, basins, all vessels of altar; spread covering of fine leather over it and put in its poles.

familiar.text: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins, and put to the staves of it.

modern.text: and place on it all the vessels used to serve there: the firepans, meat forks, shovels, and sprinkling bowls—all the equipment of the altar. They are to spread over it a covering of fine leather and insert the poles.

original.text: וְנָתְנ֣וּ עָ֠לָיו אֶֽת כָּל כֵּלָ֞יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְֽשָׁרְת֧וּ עָלָ֣יו בָּהֶ֗ם אֶת הַמַּחְתֹּ֤ת אֶת הַמִּזְלָגֹת֙ וְאֶת הַיָּעִ֣ים וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָקֹ֔ת כֹּ֖ל כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּפָרְשׂ֣וּ עָלָ֗יו כְּס֛וּי ע֥וֹר תַּ֖חַשׁ וְשָׂמ֥וּ בַדָּֽיו

verses.restored: When Aaron and his sons finish covering holy place and all vessels of holy place as camp sets out, afterward sons of Kohath shall come to carry, but they shall not touch holy thing, lest they die. These are burden of sons of Kohath in tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy objects, or they will die. These are the transportation duties of the Kohathites regarding the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וְכִלָּ֣ה אַֽהֲרֹן וּ֠בָנָיו לְכַסֹּ֨ת אֶת הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ וְאֶת כָּל כְּלֵ֣י הַקֹּדֶשׁ֮ בִּנְסֹ֣עַ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה֒ וְאַחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן יָבֹ֤אוּ בְנֵי קְהָת֙ לָשֵׂ֔את וְלֹֽא יִגְּע֥וּ אֶל הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ וָמֵ֑תוּ אֵ֛לֶּה מַשָּׂ֥א בְנֵֽי קְהָ֖ת בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: Oversight of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest: oil of light, fragrant incense, continual grain offering, anointing oil, oversight of all dwelling-place and all in it, holy place and its vessels.

familiar.text: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.

modern.text: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest shall oversee the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil. He has oversight of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including the holy objects and their utensils.”

original.text: וּפְקֻדַּ֞ת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר בֶּן אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמָּאוֹר֙ וּקְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֔ים וּמִנְחַ֥ת הַתָּמִ֖יד וְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֑ה פְּקֻדַּ֗ת כָּל הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְכָל אֲשֶׁר בּ֔וֹ בְּקֹ֖דֶשׁ וּבְכֵלָֽיו

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Do not cut off tribe of clans of Kohathites from midst of Levites.

familiar.text: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:

modern.text: “Do not allow the Kohathite tribal clans to be cut off from among the Levites.

original.text: אַל תַּכְרִ֕יתוּ אֶת שֵׁ֖בֶט מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י מִתּ֖וֹךְ הַלְוִיִּֽם

verses.restored: This do for them, so they may live and not die when they approach Holy of Holies: Aaron and his sons shall come and appoint them, each man to his service and burden.

familiar.text: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:

modern.text: In order that they may live and not die when they come near the most holy things, do this for them: Aaron and his sons are to go in and assign each man his task and what he is to carry.

original.text: וְזֹ֣את עֲשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֗ם וְחָיוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֔תוּ בְּגִשְׁתָּ֖ם אֶת קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ יָבֹ֔אוּ וְשָׂמ֣וּ אוֹתָ֗ם אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ עַל עֲבֹדָת֖וֹ וְאֶל מַשָּׂאֽוֹ

verses.restored: They shall not go in to see holy things even for a moment, lest they die.

familiar.text: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.

modern.text: But the Kohathites are not to go in and look at the holy objects, even for a moment, or they will die.” The Duties of the Gershonites (Numbers 3:21–26; 1 Chronicles 23:7–11)

original.text: וְלֹא יָבֹ֧אוּ לִרְא֛וֹת כְּבַלַּ֥ע אֶת הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ וָמֵֽתוּ

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: And the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Lift up head/count sons of Gershon also, by houses of fathers and clans.

familiar.text: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;

modern.text: “Take a census of the Gershonites as well, by their families and clans,

original.text: נָשֹׂ֗א אֶת רֹ֛אשׁ בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן גַּם הֵ֑ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם

verses.restored: From thirty years old and upward to fifty years old you shall count them, all entering to perform service, to do work in tent of meeting.

familiar.text: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: מִבֶּן֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה וָמַ֗עְלָה עַ֛ד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּפְקֹ֣ד אוֹתָ֑ם כָּל הַבָּא֙ לִצְבֹ֣א צָבָ֔א לַעֲבֹ֥ד עֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: This is service of clans of Gershonites, to serve and to carry.

familiar.text: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:

modern.text: This is the service of the Gershonite clans regarding work and transport:

original.text: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֔ת מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י לַעֲבֹ֖ד וּלְמַשָּֽׂא

verses.restored: They shall carry curtains of dwelling-place, tent of meeting, its covering, covering of fine leather above it, and screen for entrance of tent of meeting,

familiar.text: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers’ skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

modern.text: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting with the covering of fine leather over it, the curtains for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,

original.text: וְנָ֨שְׂא֜וּ אֶת יְרִיעֹ֤ת הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְאֶת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד מִכְסֵ֕הוּ וּמִכְסֵ֛ה הַתַּ֥חַשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְאֶ֨ת מָסַ֔ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: hangings of courtyard, screen for entrance gate of courtyard around dwelling-place and altar, their cords, and all vessels of their service; all that is made for them, so they shall serve.

familiar.text: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.

modern.text: the curtains of the courtyard, and the curtains for the entrance at the gate of the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, along with their ropes and all the equipment for their service. The Gershonites will do all that needs to be done with these items.

original.text: וְאֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶֽחָצֵ֜ר וְאֶת מָסַ֣ךְ פֶּ֣תַח שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֤ן וְעַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ סָבִ֔יב וְאֵת֙ מֵֽיתְרֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֶֽת כָּל כְּלֵ֖י עֲבֹדָתָ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵעָשֶׂ֛ה לָהֶ֖ם וְעָבָֽדוּ

verses.restored: By mouth of Aaron and his sons shall be all service of sons of Gershon, all their burdens and service; you shall appoint to them charge of all their burden.

familiar.text: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.

modern.text: All the service of the Gershonites—all their transport duties and other work—is to be done at the direction of Aaron and his sons; you are to assign to them all that they are responsible to carry.

translation_notes: The age range concerns a specific physically demanding transport service, not a measure of spiritual usefulness across the lifespan.
Aaronic covering procedures protect Kohathite workers from direct contact and sight of holy objects; this can be read as worker-safety within ritual danger.
Numbers 4:18-19 explicitly says not to let the Kohathite clans be cut off and assigns clear tasks so they may live.
Each clan receives a named burden and oversight; service is distributed, not concentrated in one elite group.
'Host' language here includes organized labor/service, not only warfare.
safety_note: Do not use Numbers 4 to discard older or younger people, rank forms of labor, or glorify lethal religious gatekeeping. The chapter emphasizes assigned responsibility, safe handling, distributed service, and preserving workers' lives.
